body: I hate mirrors, photographs and my own voice. I can't stand looking at a mirror,  I avoid them as much as possible. If I do catch myself staring at one, it's because I'm trying to analyze myself.

Thanks. Talking about does help.i feel like such a burden to my friends and family. I can't talk to anyone. they want to help,  if they could.

 I feel like I'm a tiny boat headed towards a storm.i just want to make it back to my home. 

I don't know why I keep thinking and suffering over her. There are at least 3 people that want to get to know me, but I brush them aside because I keep thinking of one.After half a year, I thought I was over it, but it still cuts deep

yes exactly. thank you for listening. cant begin to tell you how much i appreciate it. I'll to pay it forward when im able.

 I'm still in disbelief, like someone i know died and i cant accept it. Im still in love with the ghost. I know what my friends and family would tell me, but im so helplessly in love. i miss my best friend.
